data.title: Egypt turns to Poland as it explores government-brokered wheat deals
data.description:
By Sarah El Safty and Michael Hogan

Egypt agreed last month to purchase around 200,000 metric tons of Polish wheat from state-backed Elewarr and is discussing buying more, traders familiar with the government-brokered talks told Reuters.

Poland's deputy agriculture minister Małgorzata Gromadzka said last month that Elewarr had signed a contract in Egypt, while the company's CEO Marcin Roszczyk said initial deliveries would total a few hundred thousand tons and rise over time.

Egypt, one of the world's largest wheat importers, is stepping up efforts to diversify supplies and reduce its reliance on traditional procurement channels in the face of disruptions to Black Sea exports, the traders said.

Its state buyer Future of Egypt has also held discussions with officials from Russia and Ukraine on potential wheat purchases, traders said. Market participants estimated these broader talks with governments could involve up to 1 million tons over several months.

Reuters could not independently confirm these agreements or determine the commercial terms of the Polish deal, including whether it was concluded at market-based prices under standard commercial terms or involved any government support mechanisms, barter arrangements or other concessions.

Future of Egypt, Elewarr and the Polish government did not respond to requests for comment.

Egypt relies heavily on imports for a subsidised bread programme that supports tens of millions of people. Russia and Ukraine accounted for more than 82% of Egypt's wheat imports in the first half of 2026, data seen by Reuters shows.

Several traders said they doubted whether the talks would lead to large purchases, adding that even deals facilitated through diplomatic channels would ultimately be executed on commercial terms or through private suppliers.

"The Egyptians think they can get better prices if they buy in bulk, but it would be very difficult to do and would have to eventually be done via private companies or on commercial terms," one said.

RESERVES SUFFICIENT FOR SEVERAL MONTHS

The discussions do not appear to reflect immediate supply concerns. Egypt bought a record volume of wheat from local farmers this year, and authorities have repeatedly said reserves are sufficient to cover domestic demand for several months.

Traders said Egypt appears to be seeking cheaper and more secure long-term supplies amid market uncertainty.

Benchmark Chicago wheat futures have risen more than 15% since the start of July, largely due to Black Sea disruption.

Future of Egypt took over responsibility for strategic wheat imports from the General Authority for Supply Commodities (GASC) in 2024. Unlike GASC, which typically bought wheat through large international tenders, the state buyer has increasingly relied on direct negotiations with global grain suppliers.

It recently returned to the import market after months on the sidelines, Reuters reported last month, with supplies sourced from countries including France and Bulgaria.

data.title: Johnson & Johnson Seeks Expanded FDA Approval for Caplyta in Bipolar Mania
data.description:
By Colin Kellaher

Johnson & Johnson has filed for expanded U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval for its Caplyta antipsychotic medication in bipolar mania.

J&J said the filing seeks approval of Caplyta for the treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder in adults, adding that a green light would mark the fifth approved use of the drug in adults.

The New Brunswick, N.J., drugmaker last week said Caplyta had met its key goals in a second late-stage study in bipolar mania.

Caplyta, which is already approved for uses in depressive episodes associated with bipolar I or II disorder, schizophrenia and major depressive disorder, was the key assets in J&J's $14.6 billion acquisition of Intra-Cellular Therapies last year.

data.title: BYPG Forms Strategic Partnership with GCM Grosvenor to Scale High-Power Manufacturing Real Estate Strategy
data.description:
Strategic partnership will target high-powered manufacturing assets with up to $480 Million in investment capacity

AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Blue Yonder Property Group ("BYPG"), a thematic real estate investment firm focused on high-power manufacturing assets, today announced a strategic partnership with GCM Grosvenor (Nasdaq: GCMG), a leading middle market real estate platform builder and GP stakes investor. GCM Grosvenor has invested an initial $62.5 million to launch the platform, which is structured to scale up to $300 million of equity over time. With the initial investment, BYPG and GCM Grosvenor intend to build a portfolio of high-powered manufacturing facilities across high-growth U.S. markets representing approximately $480 million in aggregate property value. As part of the partnership, GCM Grosvenor will join BYPG's Board of Directors.

Founded in 2023 by Bobby Dillard and Tyler Buckler, BYPG is vertically integrated across acquisitions, asset management, development, and operations. Its principals previously led Cielo Property Group, where they executed more than $800 million in retail and office investments between 2010 and 2022. Their approach has been to identify sector shifts early, from post-crisis suburban retail to creative and technology office, and to execute directly as developers and operators. Since forming BYPG, the team has developed 250,000 square feet of bulk logistics space and repositioned 135,000 square feet of infill shallow-bay industrial.

The platform will target manufacturing facilities with in-place power infrastructure, serving manufacturers in aerospace and defense, electrification, energy, advanced materials and the digital infrastructure supply chain, with initial focus on Dallas–Fort Worth, Houston, Austin–San Antonio, Phoenix and the Carolinas' I-85 corridor. The strategy seeks to capitalize on the rapidly growing demand for manufacturing facilities with sufficient power, amid increasing constraints on the U.S. power grid.

Manufacturing now accounts for 20 percent of new industrial leasing in the Southeast and Central U.S., up from 13 percent before the pandemic, yet larger users face one- to two-year delays to secure sufficient power, according to PwC and the Urban Land Institute's Emerging Trends in Real Estate 2026. For those users, a building with power already in place is the fastest path to production. By acquiring and repositioning high-powered facilities, BYPG aims to capitalize on this supply-demand imbalance, turning existing grid capacity into ready-to-operate manufacturing space, and helping close the gap between where demand is growing and where power is available.

The first acquisition under the strategy, 2000 Clovis Barker Road in San Marcos, Texas, is a 75,276-square-foot, crane-served manufacturing facility on approximately 30 acres along the I-35 corridor between Austin and San Antonio. The property benefits from 2.5 megawatts of secured power capacity, and BYPG has executed a long-term lease with an established national industrial pipe fabrication company that will fully occupy the facility at closing.

Ermias Nessibu, Executive Director, Real Estate at GCM Grosvenor, said, "Our real estate strategy is built on partnering with specialized operators and helping them scale into institutional investment management platforms. Bobby, Tyler and the BYPG team have a proven track record of identifying emerging opportunities and executing in operationally complex sectors. Growing demand for high-power manufacturing facilities is colliding with limited suitable inventory, high development barriers and constrained access to power. We believe these structural supply-demand dynamics create a compelling investment opportunity, and we look forward to partnering with BYPG to build a leading institutional platform focused on this underserved segment of the industrial market "

Bobby Dillard, CEO and Co-Chief Investment Officer of BYPG, added, "We're grateful to GCM Grosvenor for their partnership and for the conviction they've shown in our team and this strategy. Power capacity has become one of the hardest things to replicate in industrial real estate, and manufacturers increasingly decide where to grow based on where it's available. GCM's partnership allows us to assemble a portfolio of these hard-to-replace assets at scale and deliver that capacity to the companies driving America's reindustrialization."

About Blue Yonder Property Group

Blue Yonder Property Group (BYPG) is an Austin-based real estate investment manager that builds thematic strategies around emerging market trends and dislocations. Its founders have executed more than $800 million of value-add and development investments together since 2010. BYPG's current focus is high-power manufacturing, a strategy at the intersection of infrastructure and industrial real estate that acquires and repositions existing manufacturing facilities with significant in-place power capacity and mission-critical infrastructure across high-growth U.S. markets. The firm combines operator-led execution, long-standing industry relationships and a dedicated off-market acquisitions platform. For more information, visit bypg.com.

About GCM Grosvenor

GCM Grosvenor (Nasdaq: GCMG) is a global alternative asset management solutions provider with approximately $97 billion in assets under management across private equity, infrastructure, real estate, credit, and absolute return strategies. Specializing in alternatives for more than 50 years, the firm serves a global institutional and individual client base through a team of approximately 550 professionals. GCM Grosvenor is headquartered in Chicago, with offices in New York, Toronto, London, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Seoul, and Sydney. For more information, visit gcmgrosvenor.com.

data.title: Baltic index eases on capesize, supramax weakness
data.description:
The Baltic Exchange's main sea freight index, which tracks rates for ships carrying dry bulk commodities, edged lower on Thursday, weighed by declines in capesize and supramax vessel categories.

  • The main Baltic index , tracking capesize, panamax and supramax vessels' rates, lost 13 points, or 0.5%, to 2,901 points

  • The capesize index (.BACI) fell by 35 points, or 0.8%, to 4,514 points

  • Average daily earnings for capesize vessels (.BATCA), which typically transport 150,000-metric-ton cargoes including iron ore and coal, increased $315 to $37,438

  • Iron ore futures rose on Thursday, as lower port arrivals offered some support, though falling hot metal output and widening mill margin losses limited gains

  • The panamax index (.BPNI) inched up 3 points to 2,132 points

  • Average daily earnings for panamax vessels (.BPWT), which usually carry 60,000 to 70,000 tons of coal or grain, rose by $27 to $19,188

  • The supramax index (.BSIS), for smaller vessels, lost 3 points, or 0.2%, to 1,814 points

data.title: Uber Eats Adds Auto Parts Through AutoParts.com Partnership
data.description:
WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - Ride-hailing and delivery company Uber Technologies, Inc. (UBER) announced on Thursday that it has partnered with AutoParts.com to launch an auto parts category on Uber Eats.

The company said customers across the United States will be able to shop inventory from nearly 7,000 participating locations through AutoParts.com's marketplace and fulfillment network for on-demand or scheduled delivery.

Uber said the partnership expands the range of products available through Uber Eats and adds automotive parts to its retail marketplace.

AutoParts.com connects inventory from distributors, independent suppliers and retail locations across the country, the companies said.

Shares of Uber rose 0.89% to $69.38 in premarket trading after ending Wednesday's session down 0.07%.

data.title: HCA Healthcare Collects Record-Breaking 21,857 Pounds of Medication During Eighth Annual “Crush the Crisis”
data.description:
HCA Healthcare, Inc. (), one of the nation’s leading healthcare providers, today announced that it collected a record-breaking 21,857 pounds of unused or expired medications during its eighth annual “Crush the Crisis” national prescription drug take back day. This marks the highest amount of medication collected in a single year since HCA Healthcare launched the annual event. Since launching “Crush the Crisis” as an enterprise-wide initiative in 2019, HCA Healthcare has now collected more than 130,000 pounds of unused or expired medications, helping reduce the risk of prescription drug misuse across the communities it serves.

“The record-breaking results of this year’s Crush the Crisis reflect the incredible commitment of our colleagues and community partners in driving meaningful change,” said Dr. Randy Fagin, senior vice president and chief quality officer of HCA Healthcare. “Each year, we see the impact we can make when we come together with a shared purpose. I am proud of our teams for continuing to build on this important effort to help protect the health and safety of the communities we are privileged to serve.”

HCA Healthcare facilities across the country partnered with local law enforcement to help patients and communities safely and anonymously dispose of unused or expired medications. This year, over 120 HCA Healthcare facilities participated in “Crush the Crisis,” helping remove unused or expired medications from homes with the goal of creating safer, healthier communities. The events were held in alignment with the Drug Enforcement Administration’s (DEA) National Prescription Drug Take Back Day on Oct. 24, 2026.

HCA Healthcare's commitment to reducing prescription drug misuse extends beyond its annual “Crush the Crisis” events. Drawing on data from its approximately 47 million annual patient encounters, HCA Healthcare works to reduce prescription drug misuse, improve pain management and help patients recover safely, with initiatives in surgical, emergency and other care settings, including:

  • Enhanced Surgical Recovery (ESR): uses several approaches before, during and after surgery aimed at managing pain, supporting recovery and reducing opioid use. HCA Healthcare’s ESR programs have demonstrated significant improvements in surgical recovery and patient satisfaction, including decreases in opioid usage.

  • Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances (EPCS): helps protect patients and communities by reducing opportunities for prescription drug misuse and fraud. It also gives physicians access to information they need to make safer, more informed decisions when prescribing opioids.

About HCA Healthcare

Nashville-based HCA Healthcare is one of the nation’s leading providers of healthcare services comprising 189 hospitals and approximately 2,600 ambulatory sites of care, including surgery centers, freestanding ERs, urgent care centers, and physician clinics, in 19 states and the United Kingdom. With its founding in 1968, HCA Healthcare created a new model for hospital care in the United States, using combined resources to strengthen hospitals, deliver patient-focused care and improve the practice of medicine. HCA Healthcare has conducted a number of clinical studies, including one that demonstrated that full-term delivery is healthier than early elective delivery of babies and another that identified a clinical protocol that can reduce bloodstream infections in ICU patients by 44%. HCA Healthcare is a learning health system that uses its approximately 47 million annual patient encounters to advance science, improve patient care and save lives.

All references to “Company,” “HCA” and “HCA Healthcare” as used throughout this document refer to HCA Healthcare, Inc. and its affiliates.

data.title: First Eagle Investments’ Active ETF Platform Tops $5 Billion in AUM in Just Two Years
data.description:
First Eagle Investments today announced that its actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) platform has surpassed $5 billion in assets under management as of November 11, 2026, less than two years after launching its first ETFs in late 2024. The achievement marks a significant milestone for First Eagle’s growing ETF business and highlights strong investor demand for the firm’s established actively managed investment strategies. Building on this momentum, First Eagle has expanded its ETF lineup to six funds, opening up a broader range of its time-tested investment capabilities to investors and financial advisors.

“Reaching $5 billion in assets under management is a remarkable milestone for our ETF business and reflects the trust advisors and their clients have placed in First Eagle’s investment approach,” said Frank Riccio, Head of US Wealth Solutions at First Eagle Investments. “We launched our ETF platform to bring First Eagle’s established investment capabilities to more advisors and their clients. The pace of growth demonstrates the demand for active strategies grounded in fundamental research, disciplined security selection and a long-term perspective. As we continue to expand our offerings, our focus remains on delivering investment solutions that help advisors meet their clients’ evolving needs.”

The rapid growth in First Eagle’s ETF assets under management has been led by its Global Equity ETF (FEGE) and Overseas Equity ETF (FEOE), the first two to launch in late 2024. First Eagle has since expanded its platform to encompass five equity strategies and one municipal bond strategy, providing broad market exposure across multiple asset classes and market segments through the expertise of its Global Value, Small Cap and Municipal Credit investment teams. Across the platform, First Eagle emphasizes rigorous fundamental research, high-conviction investing and a long-term focus, complemented by a risk-aware philosophy that seeks to preserve capital while capturing investment opportunities—principles that are integral to the disciplined investment approach that has long defined First Eagle.

data.title: Corpay Cross-Border Named the Official FX Partner of Hull City A.F.C
data.description:
Corpay, Inc.*, () a global leader in corporate payments, is pleased to announce that Corpay’s Cross-Border business has entered into a multi-year agreement with Hull City A.F.C to become their Official Foreign Exchange (FX) Partner.

We look forward to supporting Hull City with its foreign exchange needs as the club continues to pursue success on and off the pitch.”

data.title: Choice Properties Real Estate Investment Trust Announces Normal Course Issuer Bid
data.description:
(TSX: CHP.UN) – Choice Properties Real Estate Investment Trust (“Choice Properties” or the “Trust”) announced today that the Toronto Stock Exchange (“TSX”) has accepted a notice filed by Choice Properties of its intention to make a normal course issuer bid (“NCIB”).

The TSX notice provides that Choice Properties may, during the 12-month period commencing November 23, 2026 and terminating November 22, 2027, purchase up to 26,320,449 of Choice Properties trust units (“Units”), representing approximately 10% of the public float of the Units, by way of a NCIB over the facilities of the TSX or through alternative trading systems or by such other means as may be permitted by the TSX or under applicable law. As of November 12, 2026, Choice Properties had 328,024,272 outstanding Units. Based on the average daily trading volume of 756,709 during the last six months, daily purchases will be limited to 189,177 Units, other than block purchase exceptions.

Purchases of Units will be made in open market transactions over the facilities of the TSX or through alternative trading systems. In addition, Choice Properties may enter into forward purchase or swap contracts in connection with Units which may be settled by physical settlement, cash settlement or a combination thereof, in each case subject to regulatory approval, if required, and on such terms and at such times as shall be permitted by applicable securities laws. The forward price will be based on market price, dividend yield and market interest rates. Choice Properties may also purchase Units through private agreements or unit repurchase programs if it receives an issuer bid exemption order permitting it to make such purchases. Any purchases of Units made by way of private agreements or under unit repurchase programs may be at a discount to the prevailing market price as provided in the relevant issuer bid exemption order.

Decisions regarding the timing of future purchases of Units will be based on market conditions, Unit price and other factors. Choice Properties may elect to suspend or discontinue its NCIB at any time. Units purchased under the NCIB will be cancelled or used in connection with the Trust’s equity settled incentive plans. Choice Properties believes that the market price of Units could be such that their purchase may be an attractive and appropriate use of corporate funds. Pursuant to its previous NCIB, under which Choice Properties received approval from the TSX to purchase up to 27,436,700 Units for the period of November 21, 2025 to November 20, 2026. As at November 12, 2026, Choice Properties purchased 297,861 Units through open market purchases on the TSX and alternative trading systems at a weighted average price of $15.51.

From time to time, when Choice Properties does not possess material non-public information about itself or its securities, it may enter into a pre-defined plan with its broker to allow for the purchase of Units at times when Choice Properties ordinarily would not be active in the market due to its own internal trading blackout periods and insider trading rules. Any such plans entered into with Choice Properties’ broker will be adopted in accordance with the requirements of applicable Canadian securities laws.

About Choice Properties Real Estate Investment Trust

Choice Properties is Canada’s largest real estate investment trust, guided by a clear purpose: to create places where people thrive. This is how we build enduring value. As a national owner, operator, and developer of high-quality commercial and residential real estate, we go beyond managing assets. We create places that strengthen how tenants and communities live, work, and connect. Our platform is built on industry leadership in sustainability, community engagement, and social impact, embedded across how we operate, build, and grow. As a trusted steward of capital, we are committed to disciplined execution, long-term value creation, and responsible growth. Everything we do is guided by our core values of Care, Ownership, Respect, and Excellence.

For more information, visit Choice Properties’ website at www.choicereit.ca and Choice Properties’ issuer profile at www.sedarplus.ca.

data.title: Capacity Marine Appoints Damon Vaughan President
data.description:
Capacity Marine Corporation, a specialty marine insurance broker and part of Octave Specialty Group, Inc. (), today announced the appointment of Damon Vaughan as president, effective immediately. Vaughan succeeds Walter Wynne, who retired in May.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261119785510/en/

Damon Vaughan, President of Capacity Marine Corporation

Vaughan brings more than 40 years of marine insurance experience spanning underwriting, reinsurance, broking and program development in the U.S., London and Bermuda markets. He has extensive experience building and growing specialty marine programs, developing carrier and reinsurance relationships, and bringing new insurance products to market.

Most recently, Vaughan was a founding partner of Theta Special Risk, an insurance consulting and advisory firm focused on bringing technology and more efficient digital processes to the insurance industry. He previously served as a partner at McGill & Partners, where his responsibilities included MGA and reinsurance broking and the development of new programs and clients.

Earlier in his career, Vaughan co-founded specialty marine MGA Tidal Solutions and held senior marine insurance and reinsurance positions with The Chartfield Group, Quanta Capital Holdings, Willis Group, Guy Carpenter and C.T. Bowring. He began his insurance career in the London market with J.H. Minet.

“Damon brings tremendous depth of experience across virtually every aspect of the marine insurance market,” said Robert G. Lull, chief executive officer of Capacity Marine. “His combination of underwriting expertise, entrepreneurial experience and longstanding industry relationships makes him exceptionally well suited to lead Capacity Marine through its next phase of growth. We’re excited to welcome him to the team.”

Vaughan said: “Capacity Marine has built a strong reputation for marine expertise and service, and I’m excited for the opportunity to lead the business. I look forward to working with the team, our clients, and carrier partners to build on that foundation and identify new opportunities for continued growth.”

Lull added: “We also want to thank Walter for his leadership and contributions to Capacity Marine and wish him all the best in his retirement.”

About Capacity Marine Corporation

Capacity Marine Corporation is an insurance brokerage and reinsurance intermediary specializing in the placement of marine and international risk. Capacity Marine is a subsidiary of Octave Specialty Group, Inc. For information, visit https://capacitymarine.com/

data.title: J.P. Morgan sees Fed rate hikes at next three meetings as inflation persists
data.description:
J.P. Morgan on Thursday said it expects the US Federal Reserve to deliver quarter-point rate hikes in January and March next year, on top of a previously forecast December increase, as sticky inflation keeps the need for further tightening in play.

"These hikes aren't to deliver a bad labor market, but to preserve credibility when they have no compelling narrative for a pause," said J.P. Morgan strategists led by Michael Feroli.

  • Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has left the monetary policy path without an "overarching narrative," the brokerage said

  • "Without a narrative as a pole star, policy is more likely to be reactive to incoming data," it said

  • In a bid to control inflation, "almost all" policymakers agreed further rate hikes would be needed if the economy evolved as they expected, Fed meeting minutes showed on Wednesday

  • "The labor market has not been a source of inflationary pressure, and yet inflation remains elevated," J.P. Morgan said, adding it expects modest, positive job growth next year

  • Markets see a near-certain 25-basis-point increase in December and an 8% chance of a half-percentage-point move, according to the CME FedWatch tool

  • Brokerages BofA Global Research and Deutsche Bank also expect the central bank to hike rates at each of its next three meetings

data.title: Rohingya crisis remains unresolved as ICJ rules on Myanmar
data.description:
A long-awaited judgment from the UN's highest court on Thursday said that killings, destruction of homes and widespread sexual violence by Myanmar's security forces amounted to state-sponsored genocide of the Rohingya Muslim minority population.

The decision comes nearly a decade after a 2017 military crackdown drove more than 730,000 Rohingya into Bangladesh, and as conflict, shrinking humanitarian aid and dangerous sea crossings continue to leave many members of the community displaced and vulnerable.

WHY DID THE ROHINGYA FLEE MYANMAR?

More than 1.3 million Rohingya remain displaced across South and Southeast Asia, including 1.2 million in sprawling refugee camps in Cox's Bazar in Bangladesh, according to the United Nations.

The largest displacement began in August 2017, when Myanmar's armed forces launched an offensive following attacks by the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army insurgent group on about 30 police posts and an army base.

The military crackdown forced hundreds of thousands of Rohingya to flee into Bangladesh. Refugees described mass killings, gang rapes, torture and the burning of hundreds of villages, according to Human Rights Watch.

Myanmar's government denied the allegations, saying its forces were targeting militants.

WHAT IS THE ICJ CASE AGAINST MYANMAR?

In 2019, Gambia filed a case at the International Court of Justice (ICJ), also known as the World Court, backed by the 57-member Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, alleging that Myanmar's 2017 military offensive in Rakhine State amounted to genocide.

The ICJ judgments are final and binding, but the court has limited means of enforcement and cannot convict individuals or issue arrest warrants.

In 2019 preliminary hearings in the ICJ case, Myanmar's then leader, Aung San Suu Kyi, rejected Gambia's accusations of genocide as "incomplete and misleading".

The ICJ in January 2020 ordered Myanmar to take urgent measures to protect Rohingya people remaining in the country, including preventing possible genocidal acts and preserving evidence.

WHAT IS THE SITUATION IN RAKHINE?

Myanmar's military, led by Min Aung Hlaing, seized power in February 2021. The overthrow of Aung San Suu Kyi's elected government triggered a nationwide civil war that has killed an estimated 100,000 people and displaced more than 3.5 million.

As conflict spread, renewed fighting between Myanmar's military junta and the Arakan Army rebel group broke out in Rakhine State in November 2023, forcing more Rohingya civilians to flee to neighbouring Bangladesh.

The minority group has also faced attacks by the Arakan Army, which set alight swathes of the Rohingya settlement of Buthidaung in May 2024, Reuters has reported.

WHY CAN'T THE ROHINGYA RETURN?

As conflict rages on in Rakhine, conditions for the safe return of Rohingya refugees do not currently exist, according to aid groups.

Myanmar said in August that it had verified 308,797 people living in displacement camps in Bangladesh as former residents of Rakhine State, but repatriation would begin only when security conditions in Rakhine improve.

Some Rohingya refugees say they are not willing to go back without full rights, dignity, and citizenship.

Myanmar's government has long seen the Rohingya as illegal migrants from neighbouring Bangladesh and denied them citizenship, even though Rohingya families have lived in Myanmar for generations.

Earlier repatriation plans in 2018 and 2019 resulted in no returns.
